purpose: Prospectively expand the protected six-system qualitative validation harness to nine system targets using the same frozen ABM state vocabulary and no parameter retuning.

targets.observed_chain: common-ish matching decline -> divergent pollen and floral responses
physical access failure -> directional pollen transfer -> morph-specific fruit asymmetry
signed functional mismatch -> contact/robbing/resource change -> high reproductive performance
frozen signed-position prediction -> observed direction opposite/nonconcordant
island selfing/corolla difference without detected current island service deficit
visitor/visitation contrast -> similar breeding index but reduced realized reproductive performance on another axis
lower island hummingbird visitation -> lineage-specific generalization, pollination-system transition or autonomous assurance rather than universal autofertility
native bird functional loss -> stronger pollen limitation -> lower seed production -> lower recruitment/density
bird extirpation -> zero bird visitation on Guam -> lower seed set in two plants -> lower Bruguiera recruitment

expected_frozen_class_readout_without_re.propagates_same_direction: frozen same-sign capability available only at qualitative sign-class level
expected_frozen_class_readout_without_re.buffered_or_resilient: frozen network-context buffering class available; empirical mapping unresolved
expected_frozen_class_readout_without_re.buffered_or_alternative_mechanism: synthetic buffering class available; historical/establishment mapping unresolved
expected_frozen_class_readout_without_re.reproductive_axes_decouple: empirical constraint, not one synthetic state target

claim_boundary: The three additions increase independent challenge of already-existing state classes; they do not strengthen a causal claim by model fitting. New Zealand and the Marianas test qualitative propagation, Caribbean Gesneriaceae tests qualitative branching, and the original Dominica failure remains protected.
